# dsh-decision-tools
**Ask a local model for probabilities, not prose.** Two DSH tools turn bounded judgements into cheap
for probabilities, not prose.** Two DSH tools turn bounded judgements into cheap, repeatable calls:
| Tool | What it answers | Typical use |
| `decision` | One criterion over 1–64 items, or up to 64 different questions — in **one** call | Fi

lter a list, classify tickets, route requests, rank candidates, "does this log mean failure?" |
| `m
onitor` | Re-samples one source until your criterion holds | Wait for a build to finish, a line to a
ppear, a job to fail |
Judgements run on **your own Ollama** (`/v1/systemone`). Nothing goes to a cloud provider, and the m
aterial never has to enter your conversation.
## Why
- **Cheap by design** — the rubric is sent **once**, and one call judges up to 64 items. Looping one

call per item is the expensive anti-pattern.
- **Material stays out of your context** — pass a work

space file, a glob, or another tool's raw output; you only read back the answers.
- **Honest output*
* — every answer is a probability plus `confidence`, partial work is reported in `coverage`, and `no
tes` says what the plugin did.
## Requirements

- DSH desktop with this plugin enabled (see Install).
- A local Ollama serving the decision model —

default `tev1:0.8b`, override per call with `model`.
- No API key; the judgement itself makes no out

bound call.
- For image material: a vision-capable model (`clef` / `clef-flash`). `tev1` / `nimble`
return `does not support vision`.

### Using a different local model
The shipped defaults (`baseUrl` = `http://localhost:11434`, `defaultModel` = `tev1:0.8b`, and the fo
ur-rung `ladder`) are a **snapshot**. Any Ollama model that answers the System One endpoint works:

- pin one for a call — `model: "<name>"` (disables capacity picking and escalation);
- change the se
dder: [{ model, numCtx }]` (see Configuration).
To see what is actually installed, and get a paste-ready ladder:

`numCtx` comes from `/api/show`'s declared context length — an upper bound; the runtime `num_ctx` ca
s from `/api/show`'s declared context length — an upper bound; the runtime `num_ctx` can be smaller.
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## `decision`: one call, one mode
Give `material` plus **exactly one** mode:
| Mode | Shape | Meaning |
| Batch | `rubric` + `items` + `type` (+ `criteria`) | One shared criterion, judged independently pe

r item |
| Mixed | `questions` | Up to 64 different questions about the same material |
| Parameter | Required | Notes |
| `material` | yes | Inline string, `{file}`, `{glob}`, `{tool}`, `{images}`, or `{text, images}` |

| `rubric` | batch | The one shared criterion; the wire layer repeats it for the model |
| `items` |

batch | 1–64 self-contained items; plain strings are valid |
| `questions` | mixed | 1–64 `{name, t

ype, instructions, criteria?}` |
| `type` | batch | `choice` / `noul` / `score` (mixed: per question
| no | `quick` (no escalation/batching), `normal` (default), `deep` (may chunk); ignored for images

|
| `model` | no | Pin a model; disables capacity choice and escalation |
**Material forms**: inline text · `{ file: { path, startLine?, endLine? } }` · `{ glob: { pattern, l
imit? } }` · `{ images: ["a.png"] }` (or `{ text, images }`) · `{ tool: { name, arguments? } }`. A t
ool's raw output never enters your context; the full text is spilled and returned as `material.spill
Path`. `text`/`file`/`glob` may be combined with `images`; `tool` cannot be combined with any other
form, and the plugin's own tools are refused.
**Images**: workspace-relative PNG/JPEG/WebP paths (1–8; ≤16 MiB each, ≤24 MiB total raw, request bo
dy ≤32 MiB). The plugin reads, magic-checks and base64-encodes them; the bytes never enter your cont
ext. Image requests require a vision model and run as a single request — `depth` is ignored (no esca
lation, batching or scanning). Output includes `material.images` (`count`/`bytes`/`encodedBytes`/`fo
batching or scanning). Output includes `material.images` (`count`/`bytes`/`encodedBytes`/`formats`).
[该节后续省略]
## `monitor`: wait for an event
Samples one source on an interval, asks the same rubric each time, and counts hits. `once` returns w
hen `countThreshold` is reached (or the deadline expires); `continuous` runs to the deadline and ret
urns the accumulated `count`. It **never** kills, retries, or cancels anything.
| Source | Keys | Reads |
| `job` | `id?`, `select?` (`newest`/`oldest`), `jobKind?` | A background job's output (default: new

est of this session) |
| `file` | `path`, `startLine?`, `endLine?` | Workspace-relative file |
| `gl

ob` | `pattern`, `limit?` | Matched files, concatenated |
| `command` | `argv` | Re-runs a host comm

and through the plugin's upstream pipe |
[该节后续省略]
## No compatibility layer
This is a one-time structural upgrade, not a version transition. Old row ids (`decision-tools-tool`)
and old config keys (`decisionEnabled` / `monitorEnabled`) are not accepted; use the four rows and
three Config tables above. See docs/architecture.md for the as-is contract and docs/use-cases.md for
es above. See docs/architecture.md for the as-is contract and docs/use-cases.md for worked examples.
